voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus considers killing the sleeping giant but realizes the entrance stone would trap them forever.
At dawn Polyphemus eats two more men and leaves with the flock, sealing the cave again.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus selects a green olive trunk, cuts and smooths it into a stake, and hardens its point in the fire.
The men hide the stake beneath dung and draw lots for four helpers.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Here, Cyclops — drink wine on that man-flesh you have eaten, and learn what drink our ship carried. You ask my name, and I will tell it for the guest-gift you promised: Nobody is my name. Nobody — so my father and mother and all my friends call me.
